chemistry.notes: Estimated: Ford says the SK Innovation high-nickel NCM (Nickel 9) cell is mass produced for the F-150 Lightning; Battery Design lists the ER pack as SK On NCM9 pouch. Applied to all Lightning packs (same cell family and plant).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Ford Canada says its electric vehicles use navigation-triggered battery preconditioning (route planning or choosing a DC fast charger in Connected Navigation, Google Maps or Apple Maps EV Routing). The cited page is silent on any manual control and on model years; I found no manual battery-preconditioning control documented in Ford support pages or owner forums (owners have asked for one since 2021), so automatic_with_navigation is the best fit, not a proven fact.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: ER pack nominal 349 V (Battery Design) is 400 V class; the SR pack uses the same architecture (Ford quotes the same 150 kW DC for both).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Ford 2025 spec sheet: 131 kWh of usable energy. Replaces the imported OpenEV 123 kWh (that is the 123 kWh pack).

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: Battery Design gives 142 kWh total for the 131 kWh usable ER pack (2022); the 2025 Ford sheet lists the same 131 kWh usable. Same hardware, 2022 vs 2025 compared; nothing shows a change.

dc_max_kw.notes: Ford 2025 spec sheet: 15-80 % DC fast charge, 150 kW+. OpenEV lists 155 kW (3 % apart).

ac_max_kw.notes: Ford 2025 spec sheet: onboard charger 11.3 kW / 10.5 kW (48 A) on every battery; 19.2 kW is a fleet-only option.
